display: all available strikes for selected underlying and expiry
exchange date and last-traded timestamp where available
OI, change in OI and session volume when API provides them
quote_rules: never label stale close as live
do not present stale bid/ask as executable
show unavailable fields as blank or unavailable
market_closed_study_mode.limitation: Kite historical candles do not recreate a complete historical option-chain snapshot or past chain for expired contracts; archive snapshots prospectively and never fabricate older chain data.

implementation_phases: NSE instrument master and Kite market-data/WebSocket
Market-closed option-chain study view and end-of-session snapshot archive using Kite-available quotes
Multi-leg execution state machine and reconciliation
Portfolio risk manager and audit logging
Live trading integration after current regulatory/broker checks and end-to-end validation
security: Never store broker secrets or access tokens in frontend code or source control.
